description: One stock's Coil read, headline fields: its board-percentile band (top 5%, top 10%, top quartile, middle half or bottom quartile), entry window (READY or SETUP when the name is on its book's ranked pick list; otherwise the day board's state, such as WAIT, CHASE, BASING or FALLING, for names on the day board; null with a note when neither lists it), hold label, leadership flag, price move, trading days to the next earnings report and its book's regime. Covers any S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 or macro name, one symbol per call; unknown symbols return the valid-symbol directory. Free sample: one symbol per call, headline fields, one market day delayed.
name: get_stock_read
